promptSet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: finished 1536x1024 landscape background for an interactive educational city campaign map. Reference image is ONLY for futuristic architecture/art style. REDESIGN THE COMPOSITION completely: current image is far too busy. We need a sparse readable GAME MAP with 65 percent quiet open ground/streets and just SEVEN small architecturally distinct futuristic district landmarks, each one compact building with a low annex, not entire dense urban blocks. High overhead orthographic isometric camera, visible roofs, consistent perspective. Asymmetrical city layout with varied depth, NEVER identical rows or uniform parcel tiles. The main feature is ONE BROAD CONTINUOUS WINDING PEDESTRIAN BOULEVARD, dark blue slate paving with restrained cyan curb edge lights, flowing through ALL seven districts in this order: foreground-left, lower-center, foreground-right, middle-right, center, middle-left, upper-center. Draw the unobstructed road centerline approximately through source image pixel coordinates (230,800), (650,820), (1140,760), (1240,470), (840,470), (350,350), (790,180). Connect them by broad graceful bends, do not cross any buildings, leave empty paved entrances at these seven locations where interactive numbered stops will be added later. The street is a real integrated road, not floating neon ribbon. Add subtle continuation from last stop through upper-right empty pavement to right image edge at y=510; road entering left edge y=510 joins first stop, for neighboring map sectors. Small futuristic learning architecture beside the road: a cyan portal library, compact computer lab, amber engineering hall, violet data tower, small glazed creative studio, communications building, observatory. Keep each landmark small relative to the map; main towers no taller than 2–3 stories, plenty of separation so the route is easy to trace. Coherent connected city ground, not isolated floating islands. Sophisticated detailed illustrated game asset quality, dark navy and graphite building panels, muted metallic materials, carefully restrained cyan/violet accents and a few warm windows. Minimal vegetation: only 1–2 small planters per building. Remove ALL dense vegetation, illuminated foliage, repeated street lamps, balconies, busy interiors, decorative rooftop items, clutter, signs and background skyline. No waterfront, no boats, no scattered filler houses or foreground silhouettes. Quiet dark paving margins. The eye should immediately see the winding boulevard and seven architectural landmarks, with large clean spaces to breathe. NO text, UI, names, numerals, circles/mission markers, people, watermarks, borders or baked route progress line. The runtime will overlay the route and stops.

Preserve the exact original canvas, orthographic elevated map camera, geometry, all main silhouettes, road and landmark footprints. No labels, people, text, user interface, mission circles, numbers or watermarks.
